ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached image shows a square tile pattern arranged as a 5 by 5 grid, for 25 total tiles. The shaded tiles represent the black tiles; there are 8 shaded/black tiles, and the remaining 17 tiles are white. Reasoning: Attaching a one-tile-wide border of black tiles around the whole square increases the dimensions from 5 by 5 to 7 by 7. The extended square has 7^2 = 49 total tiles. The original square had 5^2 = 25 tiles, so the new border adds 49 - 25 = 24 black tiles. The original pattern already had 8 black tiles, so the extended pattern has 8 + 24 = 32 black tiles. The number of white tiles remains 17. Therefore, the ratio of black tiles to white tiles is 32:17.
